display.purpose: One oversized route directive at a time.

headline.purpose: Editor titles and blunt empty-state instructions.

label.purpose: Routes, status, shortcuts, percentages, and metadata.

motion.name: cinematic-enter
motion.purpose: Reveal a newly selected route with a downward clip and 18px settle.

motion.name: state-inversion
motion.purpose: Transition row and control foreground/background inversion.

components.name: Action Button
components.description: A square, rule-bound action that inverts on intent.
components.css: .ds-action-button { min-height: 54px; padding: 0 12px; border: 0 solid rgba(241, 240, 237, 0.14); border-bottom-width: 1px; border-radius: 0; background: transparent; color: #b8b8b4; font: 750 12px/1 'DM Sans', sans-serif; transition: background 180ms ease, color 180ms ease; } .ds-action-button:hover, .ds-action-button:focus-visible { border-color: #f1f0ed; background: #f1f0ed; color: #111111; outline: none; } .ds-action-button:active { background: #b8b8b4; }

components.name: Primary Navigation Item
components.description: A rail or dock item whose selected state is a complete monochrome inversion.
components.css: .ds-nav-item { display: grid; width: 100%; height: 48px; grid-template-columns: 22px minmax(0, 1fr); place-items: center start; gap: 10px; padding: 0 9px; border: 0; border-radius: 0; background: transparent; color: #9a9a95; font: 750 12px/1 'DM Sans', sans-serif; transition: background 180ms ease, color 180ms ease; } .ds-nav-item:hover, .ds-nav-item:focus-visible, .ds-nav-item.ds-active { background: #f1f0ed; color: #111111; outline: none; }

components.name: Underline Field
components.description: A transparent field that uses its bottom rule as the focus surface.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 8px; color: #f1f0ed; font-family: 'DM Sans', sans-serif; } .ds-field span { color: #f1f0ed; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 800; } .ds-field input { width: 100%; min-height: 46px; padding: 0 12px; border: 0 solid rgba(241, 240, 237, 0.22); border-bottom-width: 1px; border-radius: 0; background: transparent; color: #f1f0ed; font: 650 13px/1.4 'DM Sans', sans-serif; } .ds-field input:hover { border-color: rgba(241, 240, 237, 0.5); } .ds-field input:focus-visible { border-color: #f1f0ed; background: rgba(241, 240, 237, 0.04); outline: 2px solid transparent; }

components.name: Square Toggle
components.description: A binary 44 by 24 control that inverts both frame and thumb.
components.css: .ds-toggle { position: relative; width: 44px; height: 24px; border: 1px solid rgba(241, 240, 237, 0.26); border-radius: 0; background: transparent; } .ds-toggle span { position: absolute; top: 4px; left: 4px; width: 14px; height: 14px; border-radius: 0; background: #9a9a95; transition: transform 160ms ease; } .ds-toggle.ds-on { border-color: #f1f0ed; background: #f1f0ed; } .ds-toggle.ds-on span { background: #111111; transform: translateX(20px); } .ds-toggle:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #f1f0ed; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Status Row
components.description: A rule-separated operating row that reveals priority by full inversion.
components.css: .ds-status-row { display: grid; width: 100%; min-height: 76px; grid-template-columns: 20px minmax(0, 1fr) auto 18px; align-items: center; gap: 12px; padding: 0 2px; border: 0 solid rgba(241, 240, 237, 0.1); border-bottom-width: 1px; border-radius: 0; background: transparent; color: #f1f0ed; text-align: left; transition: background 180ms ease, color 180ms ease; } .ds-status-row > span:nth-child(2) { display: grid; gap: 3px; } .ds-status-row strong { font: 800 14px/1.2 'DM Sans', sans-serif; } .ds-status-row small, .ds-status-action { color: #9a9a95; font: 600 11px/1.2 'DM Sans', sans-serif; } .ds-status-mark { width: 7px; height: 7px; background: #f1f0ed; } .ds-status-row:hover, .ds-status-row:focus-visible { background: #f1f0ed; color: #111111; outline: none; } .ds-status-row:hover small, .ds-status-row:hover .ds-status-action, .ds-status-row:focus-visible small, .ds-status-row:focus-visible .ds-status-action { color: #111111; }

components.name: Setup Progress
components.description: A two-pixel readiness track with mono measurement copy.
components.html:
Setup progress67%

4 of 6 core systems are ready.
components.css: .ds-progress { padding: 18px 0 20px; border-top: 1px solid rgba(241, 240, 237, 0.14); border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(241, 240, 237, 0.14); color: #b8b8b4; font-family: 'DM Sans', sans-serif; } .ds-progress > div:first-child { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 750; } .ds-progress strong { color: #f1f0ed; font: 600 10px/1 'IBM Plex Mono', monospace; } .ds-progress-track { height: 2px; margin-top: 12px; overflow: hidden; background: #242424; } .ds-progress-track span { display: block; height: 100%; background: #f1f0ed; } .ds-progress p { margin: 9px 0 0; color: #9a9a95; font: 600 9px/1.4 'IBM Plex Mono', monospace; }

components.name: Command Palette
components.description: A detached black command surface with an inverted active result.
components.css: .ds-command { width: min(590px, 100%); overflow: hidden; border: 1px solid rgba(241, 240, 237, 0.14); border-radius: 0; background: #111111; color: #f1f0ed; box-shadow: 0 28px 90px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.58); } .ds-command label { display: grid; min-height: 58px; grid-template-columns: 20px 1fr; align-items: center; gap: 10px; padding: 0 15px; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(241, 240, 237, 0.14); } .ds-command input { border: 0; background: transparent; color: #f1f0ed; font: 650 14px/1 'DM Sans', sans-serif; outline: 0; } .ds-command-result { display: grid; width: calc(100% - 14px); min-height: 52px; margin: 7px; padding: 0 10px; border: 0; border-radius: 0; background: #f1f0ed; color: #111111; text-align: left; } .ds-command-result strong { font: 750 12px/1.2 'DM Sans', sans-serif; } .ds-command-result small { color: #111111; font: 600 10px/1.2 'DM Sans', sans-serif; } .ds-command-result:hover, .ds-command-result:focus-visible { background: #b8b8b4; outline: none; }

components.name: Unsaved Action Bar
components.description: Detached save feedback that keeps discard quiet and save inverted.
components.css: .ds-unsaved { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; border: 1px solid rgba(241, 240, 237, 0.14); border-radius: 0; background: #111111; color: #f1f0ed; box-shadow: 0 20px 70px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.52); } .ds-unsaved > span { padding: 0 10px; font: 800 11px/1 'DM Sans', sans-serif; } .ds-unsaved button { min-height: 46px; padding: 0 11px; border: 0; border-radius: 0; background: transparent; color: #b8b8b4; font: 750 11px/1 'DM Sans', sans-serif; } .ds-unsaved button:last-child { background: #f1f0ed; color: #111111; } .ds-unsaved button:hover, .ds-unsaved button:focus-visible { background: #f1f0ed; color: #111111; outline: none; } .ds-unsaved button:active { background: #b8b8b4; }

narrative.overview:
blunt38 is a cinematic operating surface, not a friendly SaaS dashboard. It feels like a dark control room built from black equipment faces, pale signal light, hard rules, terse readouts, and one oversized directive at a time. Grayscale watcher imagery may occupy the background as atmospheric evidence that the system is alive, but controls and content always remain the dominant layer.

The interface is dense without feeling cramped: broad editorial pauses establish hierarchy, then compact rows and fields support fast operation. Selection is blunt and binary. Pale-on-black becomes black-on-pale, thin rules divide operational zones, and restrained motion reveals a route without turning the surface into spectacle.
keyCharacteristics: Monochrome equipment palette with ivory as signal and action.
Oversized editorial directives paired with compact operational text.
Square controls, thin rules, and flat in-flow surfaces.
Grayscale watcher imagery held behind the task layer.
Responsive rail that compresses and then becomes a bottom dock.

rules.name: The Inversion Rule
rules.body: State and hierarchy are expressed by reversing Signal Ivory and Command Ink, not by introducing a feature accent.

rules.name: The Five-Neutral Rule
rules.body: Product surfaces stay inside the core black-to-ivory scale; imagery is grayscale and subordinate.

rules.name: The Three-Voice Rule
rules.body: Use Unbounded for directives, DM Sans for operation, and IBM Plex Mono for route, status, shortcut, and measurement language.

rules.name: The Rail-to-Dock Rule
rules.body: The 196px rail compresses to 74px below 1100px and becomes a 68px bottom dock below 820px.

rules.name: The Flat-Until-Detached Rule
rules.body: In-flow surfaces stay flat; only detached overlays and save feedback may cast depth.

rules.name: The Hard-Edge Rule
rules.body: Operational rectangles use square corners; circles are reserved for avatars and atomic status marks.

rules.name: The Invert-on-Action Rule
rules.body: Hovered or selected controls become Signal Ivory with Command Ink text.

dos: Do let one oversized Unbounded directive establish the route before operational detail begins.
Do separate zones with one-pixel Ghost Rules and broad editorial spacing.
Do use complete ivory/ink inversion for selection, hover, and decisive action.
Do keep watcher or brand imagery grayscale, darkened, and behind the working layer.
Do preserve the rail-to-dock responsive transformation and reduced-motion fallback.
donts: Don't introduce colorful feature accents, gradients, or candy status colors into the control surface.
Don't round operational containers or turn rows into floating SaaS cards.
Don't use shadows on in-flow content or controls.
Don't let watcher imagery compete with route, server, command access, setup state, or save actions.
Don't soften terse product language into generic dashboard copy.
